answer: The Soviet Union—the country that supplied the majority of the Warsaw Pact’s top‑ranking officers—officially agreed to a unified Germany joining NATO on **12 September 1990**, when the *Two‑Plus‑Four Agreement* was signed. This treaty granted the consent of the USSR (alongside the other Allied powers) to a reunified Germany remaining within the NATO alliance.
